headline: ABC And Guardian Australia Recognized At The 2026 Walkley Awards
seoTitle: ABC And Guardian Australia Win 2026 Walkley Awards
metaDescription: The ABC and Guardian Australia received multiple honors at the 2026 Walkley Awards for excellence in journalism, covering political and social issues.
aiSummaryBullets: The ABC earned seven Walkley Awards, including the Scoop of the Year for reporting on ASIO regarding the Bondi terrorist attack.
Guardian Australia journalists received two awards for investigations into domestic violence and political travel.
Award-winning reports included coverage of Pauline Hanson's trip with Gina Rinehart and the death of Kardell Lomas.
aiContextParagraph: The Walkley Awards recognize excellence in Australian journalism across various categories. During the 2026 ceremony, the Australian Broadcasting Corporation (ABC) secured seven awards in total. A significant honor for the network was the Scoop of the Year, awarded for its investigation into intelligence failures by the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation (ASIO) prior to the Bondi terrorist attack. Guardian Australia was also honored, receiving two awards for its investigative reporting. One award recognized a feature on the systemic failures surrounding the death of Kardell Lomas, while the other acknowledged an exclusive report revealing that Senator Pauline Hanson had traveled to the United States accompanied by mining magnate Gina Rinehart. These accolades highlight the industry's focus on both political accountability and social issues throughout the year, as determined by the judging panels at this annual event.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending following its coverage by two independent outlets, reflecting the significance of these national media honors.
